wiki.extract: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG, commonly known as Porsche, is a German automobile manufacturer specializing in luxury, high-performance sports cars, SUVs and sedans, headquartered in Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The company is owned by Volkswagen AG, a controlling stake of which is owned by Porsche Automobil Holding SE, usually shortened to Porsche SE. Porsche's current lineup includes the 911, Panamera, Macan, Cayenne, and Taycan.

sampleRecentRecalls.consequence: An air suspension strut failure may cause a loss of vehicle handling and control, increasing the risk of a crash.

sampleRecentRecalls.summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Taycan vehicles.  An occupant classification system error may deactivate the front passenger air bag.
sampleRecentRecalls.consequence: An air bag that fails to deploy during a crash increases the risk of injury.
sampleRecentRecalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the front passenger seat cushion, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 24, 2025. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243.  Porsche

sampleRecentRecalls.summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Taycan vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery module.
sampleRecentRecalls.consequence: A short circuit in a high-voltage battery increases the risk of a fire.
sampleRecentRecalls.remedy: Dealers will install advanced diagnostic software as the final remedy, anticipated to be available in the first quarter of 2025.  Porsche will monitor available online vehicle data and contact owners
